infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NOVA listens for a command only after you start it or say the wake phrase. Recordings are not uploaded continuously.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: NOVA uses contact names such as mom and dad only to place a call or open a message you confirmed.
infoPlist.NSSiriUsageDescription: NOVA can be started from a Siri Shortcut. It does not replace Siri as the system assistant.
